notes: System strings of the Story engine, the save system and the journal (TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE §8). All keys use the prefix sys. — error_key values returned by Story/Saves point here.

strings.sys.err.data_invalid: The game data is damaged. Please check the installation.
strings.sys.err.wrong_type: That can’t be done like this here.
strings.sys.err.locked: This action is not available yet.
strings.sys.err.missing_clues: You still lack the clues to solve this.
strings.sys.err.answer_format: This input doesn’t fit this puzzle.
strings.sys.err.invalid_choice: This decision is not on offer.
strings.sys.err.cinematic_locked: This scene hasn’t been unlocked yet or has already been shown.
strings.sys.err.finale_locked: The ending hasn’t been reached yet. Both investigations must be complete.
strings.sys.save.migrated: A save from an older version has been carried over.
strings.sys.save.backup_available: A backup of the previous save is available.
strings.sys.save.confirm_load: Unsaved progress will be lost. Load anyway?
strings.sys.save.err.too_large: The save is too large and was not loaded.

strings.sys.save.err.format: This file is not an Ashes of Empires save.

strings.sys.save.err.delete: The save could not be deleted.
strings.sys.journal.title: Journal
strings.sys.journal.person.alexei.name: Alexei Morozov
strings.sys.journal.person.alexei.note: Railway engineer in Karsk. Inspects goods wagons and points logs, and keeps to the rules as long as they protect people.
strings.sys.journal.person.konrad.name: Konrad Adler
strings.sys.journal.person.konrad.note: Draughtsman at the Berlin Building Archive. Believes his work is politically neutral – for now.
strings.sys.journal.person.irina.name: Irina Belova
strings.sys.journal.person.irina.note: Colleague at Karsk Railyard. She protects her railway crew and is missing three wagons that now exist only on paper.
strings.sys.journal.person.emil.name: Emil Hartmann
strings.sys.journal.person.emil.note: Archivist at the Berlin Building Archive. He knows the plans that get built – and the ones that get filed away.
strings.sys.puzzle.wrong: That doesn’t fit yet. Try again – no penalty.
